mentions.name: OpenFret
mentions.description: OpenFret is an all-in-one platform for guitarists that combines smart gear inventory management, AI-powered practice sessions, real-time collaboration, and a musician community. It tracks guitar collections with auto-filled specs (woods, pickups, scale length, string changes), generates personalized tabs and lessons with VexFlow sheet music and an integrated metronome, and lets users fork and merge music tracks like code with layered recordings, version history, and worldwide collaboration. It also includes practice analytics (persistent timers, Last.fm song tracking, scale visualization, fretboard maps, chord progressions) and built-in tools such as a frequency-control guitar tuner and Strudel integration for backing tracks.
mentions.problem: The author wished an all-in-one platform for guitarists had existed when starting to play, combining gear tracking, practice, and collaboration in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building https://openfret.com/ - the all-in-one platform for guitarists that I wish existed when I started playing.

OpenFret combines everything a guitarist needs in one place: smart gear inventory management, AI-powered practice sessions, real-time collaboration tools, and a vibrant community. Think of it as "GitHub for guitarists" meets comprehensive practice tool.
